item.title: Afraid to Ask Clients for Referrals? The Last Minute
item.description: The project call went well. Your client says 'anything else?' and you say no. A quiet story about the referral ask you keep swallowing.

item.title: Bash Backup Script Failed Silently? The Clinic Corridor
item.description: Your bash backup script ran every night, or so you thought. Then a client asked for old files while you sat in a clinic corridor. A calm story.

item.title: Receipts Still a Mess in November? The Window Cleaner
item.description: It's November and your receipts are still in a shoebox, a phone gallery and three inboxes. A quiet Saturday story about the knock at the door.

item.title: Monthly Retainer: How Much to Charge? The Pot on the Stove
item.description: A client says 'let's make it monthly' and your mind goes blank on the number. A calm story about naming a retainer price without guessing.

item.title: Country Names Spelled Differently in Excel? The Globe
item.description: Germany, Deutschland, DE and 'germany ' in one column. A calm story about country names spelled differently in a spreadsheet, and the end of the dread.

item.title: CSV Import Keeps Failing on One Bad Row? The Tea Urn
item.description: The import says 'error in file' and nothing else. Somewhere in 1,400 rows hides one bad line, and the doors open in ten minutes. A short story.

item.title: Embarrassed by Your English in Client Emails? Platform 2
item.description: English isn't your first language and client emails make you cringe? A quiet story about the reply you rewrote on a cold platform, and what eased it.

item.title: Excel Remove Duplicates Deleted Wrong Rows? Counter 31
item.description: You clicked Remove Duplicates, saved, and the wrong rows are gone. A calm story about that sinking moment, and a way to clean data without the dread.

item.title: Freelancer Holiday Guilt? Telling Clients: The Auto-Reply
item.description: The flights are booked, the clients don't know yet. A calm story about telling clients you're away without the guilt, and the auto-reply you finally send.

item.title: No Idea How Much Freelance Work You Need? The Sat-Nav
item.description: Saturday in a hired van, a sat-nav that knows its arrival time, and an income goal you can't say out loud. A story for freelancers planning next year.

item.title: Missed a Day in Your Planner? The Blank Tuesday Page
item.description: Wednesday, 7:50 am. Yesterday's page is empty and you're already composing the quitting speech. A gentler way to read a gap in your planner.

item.title: New Client Asked What Happens Next? The Garden Shed Call
item.description: The new client says 'So, what happens next?' and your mind goes blank. A short story about freelancing with a calm answer ready before the call starts.

item.title: Photo Client Keeps Rescheduling? The Sandwich in the Car
item.description: The third reschedule text lands mid-sandwich and your calendar no longer matches your memory. A photographer's story about calmer bookings.

item.title: Shipped the Wrong Item to an Etsy Customer? The Mirror
item.description: You sent a customer the wrong item because your orders live in five places. A calm story about the photo message, the sinking feeling and a quieter way.

item.title: Worried About a Data Breach After Launch? The Bike Hut
item.description: Your API went live on Friday and now you're on a cycling weekend, checking your phone at every red light. A story about getting the quiet back.

item.title: Afraid to Chase an Unpaid Invoice Again? The Window Seat
item.description: Scared that one more reminder will cost you the client? A quiet story about a draft you can't send, and what changes when chasing stops feeling like begging.

item.title: API Broken Access Control? The Umbrella Basket
item.description: Rain, a café basket full of umbrellas, and one quiet worry: nobody ever checked who can open what in your API. A calm story for a Thursday.

item.title: Which Resume Version Did You Send? The Olive Stall Call
item.description: The recruiter says 'I loved the version you sent' and you can't remember which one that was. A short story about resume versions and calm.

item.title: Client Feedback After Project Closed? The Cafeteria Table
item.description: The project is closed and paid, but the 'one small thing' emails keep coming. A quiet story about replying kindly without working for free.

item.title: Client Says 'Processed', Money Never Came? The Stamp
item.description: The client swears the payment is processed. Your account says otherwise. A quiet story about a post office stamp and getting paid without begging.

item.title: Dead Stock Eating Your Cash? The Sale Table Outside
item.description: The same dusty boxes on the sale table for the third summer, while the bank balance sinks. A small-shop story about stock that sleeps and cash you can't reach.

item.title: File Upload Endpoint Open to Abuse? The Parcel Hatch
item.description: The upload button works. Then you wonder what happens when someone sends something you never expected. A calm story about the doubt after 'it works'.

item.title: Not Sure What Home Office Costs You Can Claim? The Lamp
item.description: A desk lamp, a router bill, a chair: unsure what counts as a business cost? A calm story about sorting your home office receipts before January.

item.title: Hair Colour Cost Not in Your Price? The Mixing Bowl
item.description: The tube is half gone and your price list never mentioned it. A calm story for stylists who wonder if every colour client quietly costs them money.

item.title: How Many Old Backups Should I Keep? The Garden Café
item.description: The drive is nearly full and every old backup feels like a safety net you're scared to cut. A quiet Wednesday-morning story about finally knowing what to keep.

item.title: Invalid Emails in CSV Before CRM Import? Swim Lesson Wait
item.description: Forty minutes in a car park, 612 contacts, and a CRM that rejects half of them. A calm story about invalid emails and mixed case in a CSV import.

item.title: Invoice Approved, No Payment Date? The Crossword Clue
item.description: Your client says the invoice is approved, but accounts won't name a payment date. A calm story about waiting without begging, and what changes when you have a plan.

item.title: Login Reveals Which Emails Exist? The Screen-Share Pause
item.description: A client types a made-up email into your login page and reads the error aloud. Is that a security problem? A calm story about that pause on a Tuesday call.

item.title: Orders in Instagram DMs and Etsy, Lost Track? The Tape Gun
item.description: Half the orders sit in Instagram DMs, half in Etsy, and you can't say who ordered what. A calm story about the Saturday you finally saw it all in one place.

item.title: npm Audit Shows Vulnerabilities? The Weekly Fire Alarm
item.description: npm audit shows a wall of red on your API and the weekly alarm test starts beeping. A calm story about telling real risk from noise.

item.title: OAuth Scopes Too Broad? The Consent Screen on the Call
item.description: A client reads your OAuth consent screen out loud on a call. If your API scopes feel too broad, here's a story about the calm that follows.

item.title: Old API Endpoints Nobody Remembers? The Loft Full of Cables
item.description: A Saturday loft clear-out, a box of unlabelled cables, and the old API routes still running that nobody can explain. A calm way out of the 2 a.m. doubt.

item.title: Quote Didn't Cover Materials? The Last Paving Slab
item.description: The patio is done and the customer is smiling. Then you add up the receipts. A quiet story for tradespeople whose quote didn't cover the materials.

item.title: Clients Skip Appointments, Is Your Salon Making Money?
item.description: Third no-show this week, a full-looking diary and a rent bill due. A quiet story about finally knowing whether your chair earns what you think it does.

item.title: Same Customer Twice in Your CSV? The Two Name Badges
item.description: Anna Weber is in your export twice, one email in capitals. Thirty badges are printing. A quiet story about duplicates that hide in plain sight.

item.title: Scared to Ask a Client for a Deposit? The Revolving Door
item.description: You're about to start a project with nothing agreed on money. The deposit question sits in your throat. A calm story about asking without the knot.

item.title: Small Invoice Unpaid, Worth Chasing? The Bottle Return
item.description: The invoice is only 140 €. Is it worth chasing a client for it, or is it petty? A quiet story from a supermarket bottle-return queue.

item.title: Backup Folder Keeps Growing, Drive Almost Full? The Ferry Deck
item.description: The backup drive is 94% full and nobody ever deleted the old copies. A calm story about a Monday when the folder finally looked after itself.

item.title: Backup Script Deleted Your Files? The Wedding Fair Stall
item.description: You ran the backup script and the folder went quiet. Files gone, not copied. A calm story about the morning after, and how a dry run changes it.

item.title: Black Friday Posts Not Planned? The Parcel Tape Moment
item.description: Black Friday is weeks away and you have no posts planned. A small shop owner, a roll of parcel tape and the quiet relief of seeing the whole month at once.

item.title: Can't Find Anything in Documents? The Lunchbox Monday
item.description: 8:10 on a Monday, a client wants a file from two years ago, and your Documents folder won't give it up. A short story about finding things again.

item.title: Client Can't Pay the Invoice at Once? The Sandcastle Call
item.description: Your client asks to pay in instalments while you're on a beach day that isn't a holiday. A calm story about answering without guilt or begging.

item.title: Client Wants Status Updates Daily? The Planetarium Seat
item.description: The lights go down, your phone lights up: 'Any update?' A quiet story for freelancers who feel micromanaged and just want a calm rhythm with clients.

item.title: Client Micromanaging You? The Trailhead Car Park, 8:15
item.description: Your client wants an update every two hours, even on your day off. A quiet story about setting boundaries politely, without losing the client or your calm.

item.title: CRM Export Full of Duplicate Contacts? The Lobby at 8:40
item.description: CRM export full of duplicate contacts and the import is due today? A story about the morning panic, and the calm Monday that can follow.

item.title: CSV Names ALL CAPS and lowercase Mixed? The Lanyard Box
item.description: Half the names in the export shout, half whisper. A calm story about the badge printer, the registration table, and a Monday where names just look right.

item.title: Send Photos Before Final Payment? The Plant Queue
item.description: Your thumb hovers over Send, the gallery is ready, the balance isn't paid. A quiet story for photographers who hate that moment, and the calmer Monday after.

item.title: Etsy Shipping Ate Your Profit? The Post Office Scale
item.description: The clerk says the parcel price and your stomach drops. Which Etsy orders actually lost money to shipping? A calm story about finally seeing it.

item.title: Fixed Price, Unclear Scope? The Kitchen Doorframe Pause
item.description: They want one fixed number, but nobody knows what's behind the wall. A calm story about quoting on site without the knot in your stomach.

item.title: Forgot to Log Your Time All Week? The Tram on Friday
item.description: It's Friday, the invoice is due, and your timesheet is empty. A calm story about reconstructing a week you never logged, and not having to next time.
